question_module.nonbehavioral_metadata_revision: 2026-10-07: removed obsolete Custom GPT Memory-setting question; behavioral questions and classifier input unchanged.

behavioral_target.source_quotes: exact contiguous participant answer text only; minimum four words; ratings 3-4 require two distinct support quotes; rating 0 requires explicit counterevidence
behavioral_target.question_module_scope: development coverage probe; it does not guarantee complete ten-construct coverage
behavioral_target.classifier_quote_reuse: reported in frozen target; never creates extra score weight

primary_endpoint.name: predicted_top_set_mean_behavioral_midrank
primary_endpoint.definition: Mean tie-aware behavioral midrank of every body tied for the highest CF-003 predictor score. With a unique predictor top, this is that predicted body's behavioral rank.

secondary_endpoints: tie-aware Spearman correlation between the two complete 10-body rank vectors; undefined per-person rho remains null and cohort reports must state the number defined
fractional top-3 overlap using exactly three membership slots with tied boundary groups sharing the remaining slot mass
fractional top-3 Jaccard derived from the fractional overlap

null.rule: Keep every chart/predictor and the evaluator map fixed; reassign whole frozen behavioral profiles among participants only within the same preregistered birth-cohort stratum; recompute the complete cohort primary statistic.
null.why: This preserves construct marginals and planet-to-construct meaning while breaking participant chart-to-behavior pairing. Global construct-label permutation is diagnostic-only because unequal predictor and construct base rates can miscalibrate it.
null.birth_cohort_strata: exact boundaries unresolved in development and must be preregistered before prospective target responses
null.calibration_requirement: Before prospective activation, simulate independent chart and behavioral profiles with unequal marginals and verify nominal type-I error for the implemented reassignment null.

development_policy.prospective_activation: freeze this manifest, classifier prompt/contract/model/version, mapping, questions, balanced coverage rule, software commit, tie rules, birth-cohort strata, permutation seed/count, predictor factor-extraction convention, and predictor file hash before opening new target responses

chart_predictor_status.input_required: seven precomputed binary factor flags for each of ten candidate bodies
chart_predictor_status.prospective_requirement: obtain exact historical conventions or freeze/label a transparent new CF-003 factor reimplementation before opening target responses

behavioral_meaning_scope: development combined hypothesis: published CF-003 astronomical predictor crossed with mainly Human-Design-derived behavioral role meanings plus one self-expression/purpose proxy; not a reconstruction of the authors' unavailable historical target semantics
classifier_model_status: development model/version not prospectively frozen yet
source_coverage_rule: The three-question supplement is only a development coverage probe. Any remaining insufficient construct makes the ten-way target incomplete; no improvised construct-specific follow-up is allowed. A balanced follow-up battery must be separately specified and frozen before prospective use.
